youtube.title: A 25-Foot Wave of Molasses Killed 21 People | The Great Molasses Flood
youtube.description:
January 15, 1919: a tank holding 2.3 million gallons of molasses burst in Boston's North End. A wave up to 25 feet high moved at 35 mph, killing 21 people and injuring about 150. The tank had leaked from the start, and it was painted brown to hide the leaks.

📂 Case File #002: The Great Molasses Flood

Sources: court-appointed auditor's findings (1925) as summarized in Puleo, "Dark Tide" (2003); Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_Molasses_Flood
Photos: 1919, public domain via Wikimedia Commons. Tank-scale overlay: Wikimedia Commons user, CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Boston_Molasses_Flood_Aftermath_(original_tank_scale_superimposed).png
Narration voice: AI.
